draft.subject: Re: Weekly summary + getting your team added
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for the kind words on onboarding, and good question from your team lead: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap. I've noted that on your open tickets so you have it in writing there too.

On getting the rest of the team added: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Want me to walk you through the invites and your first project on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
